description: lib.rs:3010,3015,3045,3050 — `use` items appear after `let` statements inside test functions (tests_ecdsa_p256 and tests_rsa modules). Clippy pedantic items_after_statements fires. Fix: move `use der::Encode as _` and `use spki::der::referenced::OwnedToRef as _` to the top of each test function, before the first let-binding.
title: [rusty/pkix-path] items_after_statements in unit test functions
